svg.title: Blueprint 10: Hybrid Web SSR & Capacitor 7 Native Mobile Architecture
svg.desc: Modern Athenaeum dual-target build diagram for iqoqo v1.2.0 showing shared frontend mono-repo branching into Target A Web SSR Docker and Target B Capacitor 7 Native Mobile with v1.2.0 Multi-Server Registry, per-server Keychain token isolation, and per-server offline-cache.ts resilience.
svg.text: Blueprint 10: Hybrid Web SSR & Capacitor 7 Native Mobile Architecture
Dual-Target Next.js 16 Mono-Repo • v1.2.0 Multi-Server Registry • Per-Server Keychain & Scoped Offline Cache

g.text: • Page-level auth routing & redirects execute natively on Node.js runtime
• Accommodates complex SPARQL queries & 50MP batch cover uploads
• Internal Docker bridge hop (iqoqo_default) with zero public round-trip
• TanStack Query v5 caching, retries & optimistic UI updates
Blocks JavaScript / XSS access to raw session credentials
2. Logout → Forwards Bearer JWT to POST /api/auth/logout
Revokes jti in auth.token_blocklist BEFORE clearing browser cookie
• Flask backend enforces cryptographic JWT signature & RBAC matrix
• Intercepts .html & .txt Next Flight requests for dynamic routes → _placeholder
• useResolvedRouteParam() resolves live URL segment at runtime
• Exact slug parity maintained across all 5 static /help/* articles
• Add, rename, switch, or remove libraries via <ServerSelector />,
• Bearer Authorization transport across capacitor://localhost & https://localhost
• Google / Apple Native OAuth → single-use OAuthExchangeCode
Isolated per server: iqoqo_auth_token_<serverId> in iOS Keychain / Android EncryptedSharedPrefs
• Queues offline manual scans per serverId
• Syncs queued entries without duplicate POSTs
• Purges cache ONLY on server removal or
